scope: DEV only. No validation, locked, paper or IW1 window. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user; any forward window needs the user's explicit go.

universe.rule: exactly ADR 0047/0094: every USDT-quoted symbol of the public Binance USDT-M archive incl. delisted; at rebalance day i cut-off = bar i-2; eligible = >=60 daily bars, open at day i, 30-day mean quote volume >= 2,000,000 USDT; ranked desc; U50 = ranks 1..50, W200 = ranks 1..200
universe.spot_mapping: spot symbol = perp symbol with a leading '1000000', '1000' or '1M' unit prefix removed (e.g. 1000PEPEUSDT -> PEPEUSDT); a perp with no spot USDT pair in the spot archive has no V signal (excluded from V ranks, never imputed)

S1.use: the only segment that decides anything

S2.use: reported, and used only in the fixed S2 > 0.5 condition

segments.rebalance: cross-sectional trials rebalance every 14 days on the Monday grid of wide_universe_dev.rebalance_days (anchor S1 2021-03-01, S2 2024-08-19); signal at bar i-2, trade at the open of day i, weights drift between rebalances, real funding
segments.P_family_eval_start: first grid day whose cut-179 is inside the segment: S1 from 2021-07-05 or the first grid day after, S2 from 2024-12-16 or the first grid day after

trials.P1_HIGH180_U50: signal = close[cut] / max(close[cut-179..cut]); quintile long-short (wide_universe_dev.pick), long the names nearest their 180-day high, short the farthest; U50
trials.V1_PERPSPOT_LEVEL_U50: signal = ln(sum perp quote volume cut-27..cut / sum spot quote volume cut-27..cut), needs >=20 spot days; long the LOWEST quintile (spot-driven), short the highest (leverage-driven); U50
trials.V2_PERPSPOT_CHANGE_U50: signal = mean daily ln(perp qv/spot qv) over cut-6..cut minus mean over cut-34..cut-7 (>=5 and >=20 valid days); long the lowest quintile (falling leverage share), short the highest; U50
trials.B1_PREMIUM_MOM_U50: signal = mean daily premium-index close over cut-6..cut minus mean over cut-34..cut-7 (>=5 and >=20 days); long the lowest quintile, short the highest (rising basis = crowding unwinds); U50
trials.E1_SPOTLIST_SHORT_H7: event: first day L of the spot USDT pair in the spot archive where the perp already had >=30 daily bars before L and the perp is eligible (>=2M 30d volume) at L+1; short the perp at the open of L+1, cover at the open of L+8; each event weight -0.10 of capital (fixed, no compounding), concurrent events add; events where L+1 or L+8 falls outside an allowed segment are dropped
trials.E1_SPOTLIST_SHORT_H28: same with cover at the open of L+29

cost: ADR 0041 calibrated cost (wide_universe_dev.side_cost row 'cal', ESTIMATED from measured books, volume-scaled) on every weight change incl. event entry and exit; rows cal_x2 and cal_tail_x2 are conditions; cost0 is reference only
decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094: DEV_PROMISING only if S1 annual SR (cal) > expected max SR of 7 null trials, market alpha t >= 2 (market = equal-weight U50 daily return), both S1 halves SR > 0, S2 SR > 0.5, S1 SR > 0 under cal_x2 and cal_tail_x2. Event trials: the daily P&L series over the whole segment (days with no open event = 0). Event trials with fewer than 20 S1 events are INSUFFICIENT_EVENTS = NOT_PROMISING. Everything else NOT_PROMISING. Also reported, not relaxing anything: DSR at N=7 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 over the 5 cross-sectional trials on their common S1 span, null max at cumulative N.
power_note_written_before_results: 14-day rebalance gives about 60 S1 decisions (P family about 50). Even so, the minimum detectable annual SR at 80% power, Bonferroni 0.05/7, over 2.2-2.7 years is about 2.0-2.2; at cumulative N (~12,200 trials) the null max is about 2.4-2.7. Small true effects (SR 0.5-1) will mostly read NOT_PROMISING.
after_result: Any variant (other lookback, hold, quintile, direction, universe) is a NEW trial needing a new prereg. Trial count +7 regardless of result.
